reason: Adds the rational- and residue-matrix fixture record emitters and their JSON serializers for the new HexDet oracle streams. Every addition is a new declaration in the conformance emit helper library; no existing declaration, compiler rule or fixture shape changes. Hex.Conformance.Emit is a fixture-writing module used only by the *_emit_fixtures executables, and is not in the integer-factorization service call graph, so this transition is runtime-neutral for the retained factorization sweep.
